limitations: No classification of the boundary of the optimal-center locus, unrestricted linear symmetry group, or all lower-dimensional faces. The first public source date is the 2018-07-20 arXiv version of the geometric symmetric-edge-polytope source initiating this study, not the publication date of earlier supporting variance literature. Bibliographic overlap with unindexed geometric treatments remains possible.
scientific_integrity: Real zero-sum Euclidean transportation norm, finite metric Cartesian products under sum distance, uniform product measure. The scalar maximal-variance inequality is credited explicitly to Bobkov–Houdré (1996). The new claim is the geometric identification and factorization of contacting facets and affine incenter locus, with sharp rectangular-grid evaluation. Independent scientific audit is not performed.
title: Euclidean inball contact tensorization for finite metric transportation norms
